_doc: Bloat firewall. Ceilings are NON-INCREASING and ratchet DOWN as code shrinks, never up without operator approval. Two operator-approved exceptions on record: the 2026-08-03 one-time test-pool correction at the Dream V1 landing (maxima 11600/85000), and the 2026-08-14 Breakthrough Pass raise (+300 production for the deterministic editor safety checks and the multi-page differentiation producer; operator authorized ratcheting mechanical budgets blocking the MVP, recorded here and in the campaign report). Enforced by scripts/check-foundation-budget.mjs (npm run guard:foundation). Foundation is frozen; see AGENTS.md for the growth policy and the 8-field feature rule. Third and fourth operator-authorized exceptions, 2026-08-16 final outcome run: ceilings set to the exact landed counts after the operator rejected the prior completion and ordered the continuation (canonical demand units + loader + history aggregate consumer, demand-recovery producer, answer-journey reasoning, self-starting backfill, generalized rendered reads, banked-copy earning re-read, and their tests); every ceiling remains exact-count and non-increasing from here. 2026-08-18 tenth-contract reconciliation, operator-approved interactively BEFORE shipping: the unapproved fifth raise was reversed (production ratcheted DOWN to 74,374 after deleting four dead modules; combined down to 87,097; exports back to 1,343 exact), and the operator approved tests at the exact landed count 12,723 because every line over the old ceiling is the contract's own counterexample suite (proposition search, typed failures, coverage chunks, dedupe, publisher diversity, global attempt bound, one canonical day, migration immutability, publish-not-called). Fifth authorized adjustment, 2026-08-19 AEO reconstruction (program clause: smallest exact ceiling adjustment after superseded deletion, recorded precisely): production DOWN 74374 to 73939 and exports DOWN 1343 to 1339 after deleting the Profound-era parallel AI record (canonical-store, cold-store, prompt-answer-observations dual write, citation-observations, the deep-dive ai_absence door and aiDemand); tests UP 12723 to 12835 for the AEO counterexample suite (fan-out recurrence, AI-seeded demand, staged cases, recurrence ranking, typed shipment scope, exact-scope measurement); combined DOWN 87097 to 86774. Net ceiling change is MINUS 323 lines. Sixth authorized adjustment, 2026-08-21, operator approval recorded verbatim after Codex accepted Phase 2 of the correction program: ceilings set to the exact landed counts of the deployed hardening pass (production 75,038; tests 13,815; combined 88,853; exports 1,374). The added code protects money (the pause is a spending boundary with never-cached permission), tenant security (service-role-only hardened verdict writer), concurrency (owner-token rebuild lease), durable decisions (ai_case_dispositions with superseded semantics) and the counterexample tests that caught live defects. This is a ratchet to exact counts, not permission for growth: Phases 3 to 10 must replace or delete enough to stay inside these numbers, and every ceiling ratchets DOWN when replacement work deletes code. Seventh authorized adjustment, 2026-08-21, operator approval recorded verbatim after Codex accepted Closures A, B and C1 and C2's measurement methodology: ceilings set to the exact landed counts of the measurement replacement (production 75,605; tests 14,276; combined 89,881; exports 1,387), which remains 10,119 lines below the permanent 100,000 MVP cap. What the overage buys: the three-part verdict rule that replaced FLAT_BAND (practical threshold, interval excluding zero, adequate denominators), same-instrument controls off the account's own unaffected questions with their drift subtracted, per-engine verdicts with an honest split, terminal Not-measurable, the authorship label, and the counterexample suite the correction program itself specified. Exact-count ratchet, not permission to grow. 2026-08-26 terminal-closure adjustment (operator pre-authorized in the terminal contract): after deleting the 1,600-line proof-timeline subsystem and the dead cost/continuation plumbing, production max RATCHETED DOWN 75605->74500 and exports 1387->1370 (landed: 73,871 prod, 1,362 exports); tests 14276->14500 for the composed acceptance contracts; combined 89881->89100; per-file ceilings set to the landed sizes of the five closure files plus research-steps.ts (546) and bundle-detail.tsx (507) grandfathered at their long-standing sizes. Non-increasing from here. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +0, tests +128, combined +178; per-file src/domains/decision/drafted-copy.ts 718 to 739. Reason: Round 1 of the research-to-useful-change loop replaces two contracts and deletes the paths they superseded in the same commits. Deleted in decision (D1): the evaluator's universal improvesPage clause and usefulAndNatural form rules (EVALUATOR_SYSTEM itself), the TASK table and its evidence-id selector, synthesisTooThin, GAIN.TOO_THIN, the TITLE_SHAPE_CLAUSE bans and the blanket call-to-action refusal. Deleted in runtime (R1): firstRound and the first-round reservation with its 'starting this needs N charged calls' decline, PhaseOutcome.pause and its driveRun handler, ResearchRunError.failures, and the three duplicated replenishReady call expressions. The replacements are one typed editorial standard per treatment read by every door (with its proof file, tests/decision/editorial-standard.test.ts, 124 lines on two synthetic tenants) and one per-drive working context with money spent rather than committed. drafted-copy.ts grows to 739 because the six standards and their shared mechanical requirements now live in one place instead of two contradictory messages; production stays at its ceiling exactly. 2026-09-05 operator-authorized adjustment (Armeen, in chat: unlimited builds, raise the code cap where a replacement genuinely needs room, provided superseded paths are deleted): production +0, tests +71, combined +71; per-file none. Reason: Round 2 of the research-to-useful-change loop, tests raised by exactly the landed proofs (D2 +54 on two synthetic tenants for the five passage verdicts, the group floor, the count rule, the repositioning exemption, the router and the draft provenance class; R2 +11 for the shared scoring context, the replay door and the waited demotion; orchestrator +6 pinning that a relational word the searcher used must be matched by the text that claims to answer). Production is unchanged at its ceiling. Deleted in decision (D2): the token-absence verdict (asked, label and the sixteen-word INFLECTION list in diagnosis.ts), PageDemand.stored and storedWords in drafted-copy.ts, the unconditional count-claim branch in drafts/draft-quality.ts, the twenty-four first-person refusal sentences. Deleted in the runtime lane (R2): whyAbove's unreachable readiness and overlap cases and the duplicated page-key spellings and measuring Set in rank-proposals.ts, the unread state.blocker write in on-visit-refresh.ts, the alphabetical sort in technical-findings.ts.

tests._note: 14650 since 2026-08-29 by explicit operator authorization, for the source-to-claim support cutover, WHICH IS LANDED: artifact v2 minted inside the fact judgement, the one authorization gate, the deterministic fallback, the backfill, and the live-shape fixtures. The suite landed at exactly 14650, so the authorized ceiling IS the ratchet: not a line of the grant is unspent headroom, and the next behaviour pays for itself by consolidation or deletion, exactly as before the grant.

domains._note: The five kernels: account, evidence, decision, measurement, runtime. No new top-level domain without operator approval.

files._note: NEW production file may not exceed newFileMax. Grandfathered files below carry a non-increasing ceiling = current size; shrink them, never grow. Clearing a file (trim under newFileMax) is encouraged.

imports._note: src/app + src/components consume the 5 kernels through their public facade (index.ts) only. Deep VALUE imports of kernel internals are forbidden; import type deep-imports are allowed (erased at compile).
imports._directionNote: Dependency direction: Account -> Evidence -> Decision -> Measurement; Runtime orchestrates. Forbidden: Evidence importing Decision/Measurement; Measurement importing Decision. Known pre-existing leaks are grandfathered below (non-increasing) and tracked for severance; no NEW leak may be added.

exports._note: Exported type/interface/class/enum/const/function symbols in src (non-test). Non-increasing; keep internal helpers/types internal. Ratchet DOWN.

markdown._note: Documentation budget. Git history is the archive. No docs/archive/. No new AUDIT/REPORT/WIP/HISTORY/ROADMAP/dated-plan docs without operator approval.

deps._note: Runtime dependencies. Adding one requires explicit operator approval.
